title: National Camp Underway for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is vital for preparing India's top junior badminton players for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: India's junior badminton squad has commenced a national coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on intensive training and strategy ahead of the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Conducts Advanced Level-1 Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: This course aims to elevate the standard of badminton coaching across India, directly benefiting the development of future national talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India successfully conducted an advanced Level-1 Coaches Course at its National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upgrade coaching expertise.

title: Regulations Released for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of these regulations sets the stage for a crucial domestic tournament, providing a platform for state teams to compete and showcase talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the Inter State Team Championships 2026, detailing eligibility, format, and other guidelines for the upcoming national competition.

title: Indian Junior Team Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships at NCE Guwahati
indian_angle: This coaching camp is crucial for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A dedicated coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on intensive training.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This rule change will significantly impact how young Indian players compete and develop within the national junior circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
